entities.summary: Berta Bonastre Peremateu is a Spanish field hockey forward who competed in the 2016 Summer Olympics. At the club level she plays in Belgium. In 2015, she received the Silver Stick award as the second best player in the Belgium's Athlon Hockey League. Her sister Silvia is also a field hockey player.
